name: How long does a sliding door lock replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a sliding door lock replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard sliding door lock replacements can be completed within 1 to 3 hours. The exact time depends on the complexity of the lock, whether any modifications to the door frame are needed, and the condition of the existing hardware. Our technicians work efficiently to ensure your new lock is installed correctly and functions smoothly, minimizing disruption to your daily routine. We prioritize quality and security in every installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard sliding door lock replacement typically takes 1 to 3 hours, depending on lock complexity and door condition.
